title: Adaptive Inverse-Cell Corrections for Dyadic Rough-Transport Causal Functionals
banked_reason: The promised sharp same-original-array minimax frontier is substituted by an explicitly unmatched baseline lower bound plus attainable correction envelopes; no evaluable r_star or matching T_star bracket is delivered.
proof_attempt_summary: Proved baseline node/edge lower floors, developed cubic and radius-adaptive quadratic original-array corrections, and constructed finite-sample whole-parent honest bands. Repeated maximality audits exhausted concrete degree, endpoint-resolution and truncation improvements in the proved family. Matching normalized complete-array likelihood converses and the parent-versus-subclass width modulus remain open; no Lean formalization was entered.
tldr: Total original-array procedures publicly select degree-two and degree-three inverse-cell corrections and the stratified fallback. Radius-adaptive degree two attains the explicit envelope \(F_2=\min\{1,z_n^{3/10}+\min(\epsilon^{12/13}n^{-2/13},n^{-2/7})\}\), where \(z_n=\log(e n)/n\). Selecting also degree three gives five asymptotic correction regimes: \(n^{-15/38}\), \(\epsilon^{16/17}n^{-5/34}\), \(z_n^{3/10}\), \(\epsilon^{12/13}n^{-2/13}\), and \(n^{-2/7}\), with all public cutoffs and finite-size branches derived. Separate continuous bands have at least \(0.90\) simultaneous coverage on the whole parent at each finite size. Their quadratic row-transfer cost is subordinate to the same envelope; their cubic transfer cost remains explicit. The original-array lower floor remains unmatched. Sharp rough-nuisance risk, globally honest width and the comparability of their optima remain residual questions.
gap: Ordinary dyadic density rates, finite-category counterfactual weighting and positive-projection dyadic DML are established. The inspected results do not give the rough continuous-transport frontier over arbitrary shrinking \(D\), or its finite-sample parent-honest width counterpart in the retained array experiment.
fill: The kernel determines explicit constant-factor risk and honest-width functions on a fixed bespoke benchmark class and constructs total original-data attainers. Its positive conditional-density envelope, uniform conditional outcome derivative bounds and two-population projection radius are maintained model restrictions, not CFU assumptions. Preliminary algebra is supporting material; the matched frontier is the completion criterion.
